net_metric_semantics.net30_and_net50_are: Direction-held cost-adjusted relative-wealth annualized excess proxy against a matched benchmark; decimal fraction, .02=2% and .0025=.25%.
net_metric_semantics.p25_fold_net_is: 25th percentile of the five matched chronological fold relative-wealth annualized excesses; not absolute held-side fold profits.
net_metric_semantics.new_potential_daily_ledger_requires_expl: If paired daily net ledgers are used, exponent uses actual joint holding-day count; benchmark cost/basis and complete-date support must be declared. No implicit field conversion is made in this audit.

BH_review.math_bound_without_family: For valid raw p in a specified BH family of size m, p <= adjusted q <= min(1,m*p); missing family membership/rank prevents a tighter certified value.
BH_review.needed: Source-bound complete hypothesis/test family and exact p values from matching fixed definitions, windows and endpoints, including failures or explicit missing outcomes; define duplicates/control/window counting before adjustment. Fresh frozen OOS tests are a separate route, not a retroactive reset of the exposed search history.
